title: The 10 Commandments of Noble Natties
summary: NH reclaims 'noble natty', originally an insult, and lays out ten commandments for natural lifters: treat the body as a temple, reject magic pills and shortcuts, don't idolize anyone, train religiously, uplift fellow naturals, stop blaming genetics, be honest with yourself, honour your ancestors and keep evolving spiritually.
claims: Noble natty started as an insult against naturals, but he embraces it as the perfect name for their cause
Commandment 1, treat your body like a temple: 80-90 years ago natural bodybuilding went with health, and the most muscular men lived longest; with the same genetics we can bring that back

Commandment 2, seek no magic pills: a product that truly works is probably a steroid that replaces your own anabolism, otherwise it is a bunk supplement; either way falling for it shows a lack of willpower
Commandment 3, don't even desire shortcuts: temptations like skipping the gym or eating McDonald's never disappear, so you must keep refusing them
Commandment 4, don't idolize anyone: fanboying gives up your individuality, and natural lifters fanboying PED users is the worst case; take knowledge and inspiration but be your own master
Commandment 5, train religiously: bring the repetition, consistency and spirit of daily prayer to lifting, with a goal body in mind, and you will not quit
Being drug-free is the minimum; noble natties must build big, strong bodies to prove you can be natural and big, and skinny members are on borrowed time
Commandment 6, don't bring your brother down: naturals accusing each other of lying or being enhanced is jealousy that takes you away from yourself; a bigger man is just ahead of you on the path
He is bigger than many viewers because he started sooner and never gave up, not because of different potential
All natural lifters, whether bodybuilders, calisthenics athletes or powerlifters, are brothers if they are in it for the long term
Commandment 7, don't covet your neighbour's genetics: genetics talk was planted by PED users, focuses you on what you cannot control and gives ectomorph-style excuses; only work changes your fate
Commandment 8, don't lie to yourself: examine what is wrong in your life honestly; claims of bad genetics, no time or no resources are lies
Commandment 9, honour your ancestors: blaming genetics insults those who struggled so you could exist; loving where you come from is also self-love
Commandment 10, keep seeking spiritual evolution: stagnation is death, and the best natural physiques were built by intelligent people never satisfied with their knowledge
Beyond health and performance, the deeper value of staying natural is virtue
